How to try it:

1. Open the "Indicator" tweak above the artboard.
2. Switch between OICR / Policy Change / Innovation Use / Innovation Development / Capacity Sharing.
3. Watch "Impact Outcomes" appear only for OICR, Policy Change and Innovation Use — tagged NEW only for Innovation Use, since that's the one this proposal adds.

All dropdowns, checkboxes, the Research Areas search box and Save button are functional.

Spec: docs/specs/changes/add-strategic-outcomes-field/proposal.md

Sample data note: project / objective / outcome / SDG labels are illustrative placeholders — the real CLARISA-backed catalogs weren't available in this session.
